Name: Junimo chest for Junimo woods
Author: Kurila
Description:
Why does a tech maniac like Mr. Qi have a magic chest from the Junimos?
This, and the fact that you only get the chest so late in the game, bothered me.

I like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17009]No Qi Required[/url] for how it handles many of Mr. Qi's items. But I didn't like the fact that Robin simply sold the chest.
That's why I created this mod, which adds the Junimo Chest to the purple Junimo vendor in the Junimo village of Junimo woods from SVE.
(That was a lot of Junimos just now 😉)

Unlike other goods from the village, the chest is sold for raisins, not money.
[list]
[*]10 raisins for 1 Junimo Chest.
[*]Daily limit of 2 Chests.
[/list]

[u]Some suggestions for using the chest:[/u]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29299]Fresh Farm Produce[/url]﻿. The "Fresh" state will be conserved in Junimo chests.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20658]Crystalline Junimo Chests[/url]﻿. Allows you to create a complex network of chests
